name: board-dead-heat-nested-intervals
description: Owner board 2026-11-19 (DEAD HEAT). Every 3:00 x 4 holding 2 rounds: production saved 10 cleans and 10 burpees; the board is 4 x 2 x 5 = 40 each, 4 x 200 m = 800 m of running.
rawText:
19/11/26
A. STRENGTH (Hinge)
Deadlift
4 sets x 3 reps @85+%
As singles (not Touch & Go)
In between, 3 sets of:
10 “LU” raises

B. METCON (Intervals)
Every 03:00 min x 4 rounds:
200m run
Into, 2 rounds:
5 Power Clean (Touch-and-Go)
5 Burpee
< WEIGHT: 40/60kg >
* Aim for 45-60 sec rest
** Two heats, 01:00 minute apart
